If the user switches away from the Run screen in the window between the poll dispatching loadRunCmd() and its runLoadedMsg arriving, finishLoad(screenRun) hits the early-return (m.screen is now e.g. screenBoard) and never clears the flag. stopRunActivityPolling() and switchScreen() also don't clear it. Concrete failure: on the Run screen, scroll down (scrollOffset>0), a 2s poll fires, immediately press \\\"1\\\" to go to Board, then press \\\"5\\\" to return to Run \u2014 the return's refreshCmd->loadRunCmd->runLoadedMsg->finishLoad now sees the stale autoRefreshing==true, so `!(target==screenRun && autoRefreshing)` is false and scrollOffsets[screenRun] is NOT reset to 0, leaving the returned Run view stuck at the old scroll position instead of resetting to top (it self-heals on the next load). Fix: clear m.runAutoRefreshing before the `if m.screen != target` early-return in finishLoad, or reset it in switchScreen/stopRunActivityPolling.
